DB0-07.title: Financial columns not at 3 decimal places
DB0-07.rule: PRD-004, FIN-013 — OMR authoritative precision is three decimals
why_deferred: Widening numeric(14,2) to numeric(14,3) is a data conversion on posted
financial history, not a schema tidy-up. It must run with accounting
sign-off and a reconciliation plan, which is exactly the kind of change
the WP-DB0 freeze exists to keep out of an unrelated migration.
The GL core (journal_batches / journal_lines) is ALREADY numeric(18,3),
so the authoritative ledger is compliant. The 47 columns below are
subledger and snapshot columns that GAP-009 must reconcile.
